rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (frozen page text layer) sits directly left of or just above it. Part II item numbers 14-23 are printed and match the keys by number and label. Part III row 24 prints only its number, so it is matched by item number; rows 25-27 match by printed label. Schedule 1 rows print only numbers 1-2 and column headers; ATC codes and percentage divisors are printed text, so they have no cell. Peso comb + 2-slot cents pairs are money_joins. Radios and boxes take xbox_joins. Since #113: the item 9 second line, Item 13A, the item 16 specify box and the page 2 TIN print too (derived: keys from Form1603QDraft::to_print_field_map); every other value has a reviewed not_joined reason. One writer key may fill several cells (html_ids).
